label: neiso 25 fullstop override
definition: neiso 25 fullstop-override outage re-gate (NEW KEEPER, supersedes neiso 24). The neiso-24 keeper config (run_calibration_full.py --iso NEISO --year 2023 2024 2025 --commitment --ct-deployment --hydro-backfill-year 2024 --hydro-eia930-monthly; monthly gas-hub-basis overlay on by default; CHP BTM basis fix in code) re-solved on the SHARED FULL-STOP DURATION OVERRIDE outage input (commits 56ca468/debad10): filter_revealed_outages now keeps a detected down-span if it overlaps >=24 high-net-load hours OR is a sustained full stop (span mean-CF<0.02) for >=14 continuous days, recovering the thin layer of genuinely-mechanical 14-20d weeks-long dead stops the local band still dropped at the 24h overlap margin. Measured-only (CAMPD CF + EIA-930 net load), one shared N=14/depth across all ISOs, no per-ISO constant, no price/MWh-residual (claude.md #11/#12: keep real measured outages). NEISO recovered +39 windows / 15 spans (Merrimack coal, Granite Ridge/Newington/Westbrook/Bellingham CC, Stony Brook, Pittsfield), 0.6% of detected GW-days, all small units; the STEP-1 audit (docs/multi-iso/outage-gate-fullstop-override-2026-06.md) predicted a near-no-op for NEISO and it is. ONLY the outage CSV changed vs neiso 24 (auto picked up). RESULT vs neiso 24: gas tot 54.82/58.92/60.32 TWh vs EIA-930 55.47/59.64/60.09 -> -1.2%/-1.2%/+0.4% (neiso-24 -1.5/-1.4/+0.2, marginally CLOSER to EIA-930 on 2023/24); CC_REGULAR 52.35/56.50/57.88 (neiso-24 52.32/56.48/57.75; |d|<=0.13). LMP model mean 33.96/39.24/68.74 (neiso-24 33.93/39.23/68.33) vs actual DA 36.82/41.51/67.86 -> -7.8%/-5.5%/+1.3%. Hourly hub MAE vs actual RT 15.24/14.10/21.64 (IDENTICAL to neiso-24 15.23/14.11/21.60). TAIL PRESERVED: model hrs>$200 0/0/14 (neiso-24 0/0/13; actual RT 72/43/290), 2025 model max $258.98 unchanged -- the recovered winter full-stops (Granite Ridge/Merrimack Feb 2025) add exactly one marginal 2025 scarcity hour, neither collapsing nor re-inflating the tail. The full-stop override is the structurally-correct forecast-defensible exogenous outage input (keys on net load + measured CF, regenerates forward) and produces an equivalent-or-marginally-better calibration; adopted as keeper-of-record on the correct input. Carries forward all neiso-24/23/22 caveats: priced-import seam node REQUIRED before a forecast run (imports on a fixed EIA-930 schedule); winter oil under-generation (model 0.00/0.00/0.06 vs EIA-930 0.32/0.37/1.24 TWh) is the monthly-AGT-granularity limit and the dominant remaining residual -- the >$200 winter tail (0/0/14 vs 72/43/290) is downstream of it; daily-AGT winter-oil convexity stays REJECTED as a fitted constant (derive from measured daily AGT spot, upload U4).
